text:
maya: Dropping a compact mock for roles + invite drawer. Main concerns: SSO wording, keyboard flow, and role microcopy. https://figma.com/file/NEW_MOCK

eli: Quick skim  compact looks clean. But SSO toggle label is "Enforce SSO"  sounds harsh. Suggest: "Require SSO for org sign-in" and helper text: "Existing sessions are not interrupted; new sign-ins will require SSO."

rowan: Also noticed invite drawer focus trap when opening role details inside the drawer. Tab cycles out to page. We should trap focus and ensure Esc closes both detail and drawer.

pri: Copy for role pills: current short names like "Billing" are ambiguous. Add short hover summary: "View invoices, manage payments". For screen readers announce on focus: "Billing role, permissions: view invoices, manage payments."

eli: Accessibility nit: SSO toggle uses color only. Add explicit on/off label and aria-pressed. Use icon + text, not color alone.

rowan: For mobile, hover previews won't work; use a small chevron to expand inline summary instead of relying on hover. Keep same info accessible via keyboard.

maya: Action list: update SSO copy + helper (eli), trap focus in invite drawer (rowan), add hover/expand permission summary and SR announcement (pri). Design deliverable: one compact screen with outlined role pill affordance and preview by EOD.

design-bot: Created PROD-5102: "Invite drawer focus trap & SSO helper copy" assigned to eng-ux.

eli: I'll draft the helper copy and aria text now.

pri: I'll write the SR announcement samples and post the a11y checklist.

maya: Thanks all. Will push updated figma link when done. :sparkles:
